summary: The setup for Wednesday's reopening is supportive: foreign investors kept buying, Wall Street is rallying and oil is sliding, though US inflation data on Tuesday is a hurdle.

detail.tone: A forward-looking read: the market closed modestly higher today, and the evening has brought firmer global cues. Indian markets are shut on Tuesday, so the next session is Wednesday Nov 11.
